technical.summary: Mixed momentum signals with bullish technicals (RSI rising, supertrend, OBV) offset by bearish price structure (below key moving averages, below cloud) and negative volume/accumulation indicators; weak confluence and no triggered strategies suggest waiting for clearer confirmation.

fundamental.summary: No insider buying, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 62 days create a weak fundamental setup with elevated event risk.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: medium — mixed signals with moderate amounts from junior-to-mid tier members
sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent 20) presents contrarian buy opportunity; congressional activity shows modest bullish bias 87-91 days ago, but recent news data unavailable to confirm conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with inverted yield curve, crisis VIX (343.2), rising dollar, and imminent CPI event creates hostile environment for equities; earnings in 62 days adds execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme fear sentiment (VIX crisis), RSI rising with supertrend bullish, and contrarian buy signal create asymmetric risk/reward near support (281.50) for contrarian swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price structure is decisively bearish (below EMA-9/21, SMA-50/200, Ichimoku cloud), macro environment is hostile (inverted yield curve, crisis VIX, rising DXY), CMF/AO negative, no triggered strategies, and earnings event risk in 62 days make this a weak confluence setup with unfavorable risk/reward.

decision.entry_rationale: While extreme fear sentiment and RSI rising offer contrarian appeal, price structure is decisively bearish below all key moving averages and Ichimoku cloud with negative volume confirmation (CMF, AO), creating weak confluence. Macro environment is hostile (inverted yield curve, crisis VIX, rising DXY) and earnings in 62 days add uncompensated event risk.
decision.primary_risk: Macro deterioration (inverted yield curve, crisis VIX 343.2, rising DXY) combined with earnings execution risk in 62 days creates asymmetric downside if support at 281.50 breaks; no triggered strategies reduce conviction further.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical, fundamental, and risk agents all align on bearish setup; sentiment offers only contrarian contrail without confluence
